dedupe_keys.name: bamako 100 kw grid connected rooftop photovoltaic performance

description: This deposit records the performance of an approximately 100-kilowatt rooftop photovoltaic installation at the Institute of Applied Sciences in Bamako, Mali. University researchers studied a Renewable Energies Agency pilot containing 313 monocrystalline modules. The article describes March 2020–February 2021 measurements acquired at fifteen-minute intervals, with hourly, daily and monthly summaries and meteorological context. Mendeley version 3 supplies spreadsheet, CSV and text files with an R analysis script, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is limited to one low-inclination rooftop system. Some weather and dust variables come from external databases, not the installation’s own sensors, and their resolution differs from the electrical measurements. A reviewer-assessed use is testing solar-yield, soiling or system-loss assumptions in photovoltaic simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related performance and project-analysis tool, but no parameter mapping or reproduction of the article’s results was attempted. The source files and analysis script were not downloaded.
